column1: # per-class self-time attribution, port vs C, aarch64 / Apple M4 Pro
# method: /usr/bin/sample @1ms on a steady-state loop of the SAME cell each side;
#   node self = count - sum(children); <deduplicated_symbol> attributed to its parent frame;
#   per-class ms = (class self samples / total samples) * the PAIRED encode ms from
#   benchmarks/perf_gap_2026-08-13-r1r2.tsv (n=9 interleaved paired rounds, byte-identical cells).
# SIMD attribution buckets (same profiles): SIMD_GAP = port scalar & C ships a
# SET_NEON-registered kernel; SIMD_QUAL = both sides vectorised; ALLOC = allocator+libc mem;
# SCALAR_BOTH = driver / entropy / RDOQ scalar in C too.
# CORRECTED 2026-08-13 (later, same day): restoration::compute_stats was first
# tagged SIMD_GAP. It is NOT — compute_stats_impl_neon (restoration.rs:337) is a
# real NEON kernel via dot_i16_neon (:525); R8's dead-mac_row_i32_neon finding is
# about a different helper used only by the AVX2 arm. Moving it to SIMD_QUAL takes
# 26.2->26.9; p10 unaffected, compute_stats is 0 there). The headline conclusion is
# STRENGTHENED: even less of the gap is missing SIMD coverage.
